From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Q3 Revenue Readiness: Expansion Stage Clean-up & CS Touchpoints

Team —

Quick one: Finance asked us to close out stage hygiene for all expansion (upsell) opportunities that are in the pipeline for Q3. I pulled a short list of accounts that are material to the commit number and need CS confirmation on health / milestone alignment. Attached: Q3_expansion_MA_plan.pdf (master action plan) and stage_matrix.xlsx (current stages + asks).

Top asks (please reply inline by EOD Friday):
- Confirm stage (Qualification / Commit / Contract) for every row assigned to you in stage_matrix.xlsx.
- For deals you consider Commit, add: expected close date, GCR (go/no-go risks), and any outstanding legal/procurement blockers.
- If CS is required to run an enablement/checkpoint call, put proposed dates (2 windows) and owner.

Initial list I flagged as high-impact: Acme Corp (Sarah Jenkins), Cloudwise Ltd (Procurement), and Horizon Analytics (internal notes). I’ve populated suggested stages in the sheet but want CS & Sales Ops to validate.

Why now: Finance is finalizing Q3 plan on Monday and needs a clean commit list. We don’t have to close contracts this week, but we do need accurate stage alignment and a mutual action plan for each Commit.

Marissa / Monica — can you take Acme and Horizon respectively? Dylan / Lauren — please own Cloudwise and the remaining top-10 flagged accounts.

Thanks — short replies welcome.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Karthik — thanks for the nudges. I validated Acme rows in stage_matrix.xlsx and moved the primary opportunity to "Commit - Legal" with a tentative close date of 2026-07-09. Notes below:

- Why Commit: Product trial went well, exec sponsor committed to expansion in last steering call.
- Outstanding: Standard SOW redline (Clause 8.2); procurement asked for data residency clarification (see attached excerpt).
- CS touchpoint: Recommend a 30-min readiness review next week to confirm rollout plan and success metrics. Proposed windows: May 26 10:00-11:00 PT or May 27 14:00-15:00 PT.

Sarah — looping you in to confirm which window works and whether procurement needs anything else before Legal can finalize.

Thanks everyone — quick summary and next steps for Finance alignment: 

- Acme Corp (Sarah Jenkins) => Marked as Commit (Commit - Legal). Close target: 2026-07-09. Risk: data residency confirmation (EU-only) and SOW redline on Clause 8.2. Owner: Marissa. CS readiness call scheduled 2026-05-27 14:00 PT (Monica to attend).
- Cloudwise Ltd => Dylan moved to "Qualification" pending procurement pricing approval; proposed next touch: procurement RFP follow-up (Dylan) by 2026-05-28.
- Horizon Analytics => Monica confirms as Commit - Contract with expected close 2026-07-16; Monica to attach updated MA plan to the deal record.

Action items for this thread (please confirm done once complete):
1) Monica: join Acme readiness call and confirm success metrics; update CRM (HubSpot link below) after the call.
2) Marissa: escalate SOW redline to Legal and confirm whether we need a short addendum for data residency.
3) Dylan: push procurement follow-up and return pricing ETA by 2026-05-28.
4) Lauren: run a quick hygiene sweep on the remaining flagged top-10 and close out any stale rows by EOD Monday.

Finance note: I’ll send the commit list to Finance by Monday COB. If any deal moves to "No-go" or we identify a material risk, flag me immediately so I can exclude it from the commit.

Thanks — small, clear updates please so Finance has a clean list.
